assets.description: Industrial controllers regulating pumps and chemical dosing
Operator workstations in the control room
Plant network carrying both industrial control and office traffic
Historian server and archived sensor readings used for regulatory reporting
Maintenance laptop used to connect to industrial controllers

vulnerabilities.description: The industrial control network may not be adequately segmented from the office network
Industrial controllers may lack strong authentication or secure communication mechanisms
Operator workstations may be exposed to threats originating from office computers on the shared network
The historian server may lack adequate access controls or integrity protection
The maintenance laptop may introduce malware when connected directly to the industrial controllers

threats.description: An attacker compromises an office computer and moves through the shared network into the industrial control environment
An attacker manipulates industrial controllers to disrupt pumps or alter chemical dosing
Malware compromises an operator workstation and disrupts plant monitoring or control
An attacker modifies or deletes archived sensor readings used for regulatory reporting
An infected maintenance laptop transfers malware to the industrial controllers during servicing
